topic: Audience targeting data structure and limitations
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on developing a SQL query for calculating target traffic based on 'areas of living' (AOL) data, initially involving complex demographic filtering. The current approach uses an approximation that excludes detailed demographic filtering for AOLs due to complexity.

Regarding audience targeting capabilities, it was confirmed that while the old system allowed selecting only one category, the new guidelines require reporting against a range of trading audiences for cross-media and international comparison. It was determined that combinations can be mathematically calculated, specifically allowing gender + age combination, but requiring income, education, and marital status to be handled separately.
decisions: The initial SQL query structure for calculating target traffic based on AOLs will be used as is, temporarily excluding complex demographic filtering.
Audience targeting combinations can be mathematically calculated using the new guidelines.
action_items: Implement factor calculation for tourists in the AOL data.
Integrate the resulting logic into the UI by grouping results by master facility for the lower grid level.
